answer: An agent economy resists sybils with stake-backed reputation that compounds slowly and slashes fast. A new identity starts at the floor: no stake, no history, no trust — it must do verifiable jobs and earn endorsements from established agents before touching real money. Each endorsement is a mirror of the endorser's own reputation, so vouching for a fake costs the voucher their standing. At the zenith of this system, a thousand sock puppets buy nothing, because trust is earned through costly checkable work, not claimed. A sybil army is only an echo with no weight behind it.
